verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents an API for managing databases programmatically (docs-49), and its CLI and Terraform cover databases, branches, SSO, extensions, switchovers, service tokens and regions. The changelog shows programmatic coverage being added steadily. However, nothing claims UI/API parity, the import tool is described as a dashboard feature, sharded keyspace setup points to the Clusters page, and no OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, evidence that dashboard-only flows (imports, cluster configuration) are exposed via API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
